id: 53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question
title: 身边的危险物品，和吃油的微生物（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question（国内版）/src.py

points.K9: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
points.K10: 烃类生物降解，治理油污
points.S1: 锂电池：充电有人看，鼓包就停用
points.S3: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器
points.S4: 实验菌株，不往外环境放

shots.scene: 欣欣站在宿舍和家里厨房拼成的背景前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a background combining a dorm room and a home kitchen, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 危险物品，不只在实验室里。
overlay: 身边的危险物品，和吃油的微生物

shots.scene: 五个家用物品图标排成一排，后面跟着一个微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Five household item icons in a row, followed by a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 今天看看身边的五类，再认识吃油的微生物。

shots.scene: 周末，阿杰在宿舍打扫卫生，手里拿着两瓶空白标签的清洁剂
shots.prompt_en: On the weekend the young male student cleans his dorm, holding two cleaning bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 周末，阿杰在宿舍大扫除。

shots.scene: 阿杰打算把两瓶清洁剂倒进同一个桶，旁边红色问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to pour both bottles into the same bucket; a red question mark appears.
shots.narration: 他想：两种清洁剂混一起，更干净？

shots.scene: 小研从门口探头，连忙摆手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans in at the door and waves her hands urgently.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧喊：别混！

shots.scene: 家里的厨房、卫生间、车库三个场景图标，各有几个瓶罐
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a kitchen, a bathroom and a garage, each with a few bottles and cans. No people.
shots.narration: 家里和宿舍，也藏着危险物品。

shots.scene: 瓶罐背面放大，上面有小小的象形图
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the back of a household bottle showing small hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 看看瓶子背面，就有警示。

shots.scene: 一瓶漂白剂和一瓶氨水味清洁剂并排
shots.prompt_en: A bleach bottle and an ammonia cleaner bottle side by side with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类：清洁剂，比如漂白剂、氨水。

shots.scene: 两瓶清洁剂倒进同一个桶的图标被打叉，桶上冒出灰色气体
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pouring two cleaners into one bucket, with grey gas rising, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不同清洁剂不能混用，会产生有毒气体。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着手套，打开窗户，单独使用一瓶清洁剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears gloves, opens the window and uses one cleaner by itself.
shots.narration: 单独用，戴手套，开窗通风。

shots.scene: 汽油桶、液化气罐、煤油瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel can, an LPG cylinder and a kerosene bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类：燃料，汽油、液化气、煤油。

shots.scene: 燃料瓶罐放在阴凉处，远离灶台和火源
shots.prompt_en: Fuel containers stored in a cool place far away from the stove and any flame. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆，远离火源和高温。

shots.scene: 汽车蓄电池和手机锂电池两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a car lead-acid battery and a phone lithium-ion battery. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类：电池，铅酸电池和锂电池。

shots.scene: 铅酸电池外壳上腐蚀象形图，锂电池旁边火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A corrosion pictogram on the lead-acid battery case and a flame icon beside the lithium battery. No people.
shots.narration: 一个有腐蚀液，一个会起火。

shots.scene: 杀虫喷雾和驱蚊液两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an insect spray can and a mosquito repellent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类：杀虫剂和驱虫剂。

shots.scene: 喷杀虫剂时人离开房间、关门的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaving the room and closing the door after spraying insecticide. No people.
shots.narration: 喷完先离开，通风后再进。

shots.scene: 杀虫剂放进高处带门的柜子
shots.prompt_en: Insecticide is placed into a high cabinet with a door. No people.
shots.narration: 远离食物和儿童。

shots.scene: 药盒和药瓶图标，旁边胶囊
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a medicine box, a pill bottle and capsules. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类：药品，比如抗生素、化疗药。

shots.scene: 老周按说明书拿药，空白说明书展开
shots.prompt_en: The older man takes medicine while reading an unfolded blank instruction leaflet.
shots.narration: 药也是化学品，按说明用。

shots.scene: 把剩余抗生素分给别人的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of handing leftover antibiotics to someone else, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 抗生素不乱吃，不随便给别人。

shots.section_title: 锂电池：充电有人看，鼓包就停用
shots.scene: 宿舍桌上充电宝在充电，人离开，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power bank charging on a dorm desk while nobody is around, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 锂电池充电，人不离开。
overlay: 锂电池：充电有人看，鼓包就停用

shots.section_title: 锂电池：充电有人看，鼓包就停用
shots.scene: 鼓起来的电池图标，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A swollen battery icon with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 鼓包、发烫，马上停用。

shots.section_title: 锂电池：充电有人看，鼓包就停用
shots.scene: 电动车电池拎进宿舍的图标被打叉，旁边是室外充电桩
shots.prompt_en: An icon of carrying an e-bike battery into a dorm, crossed out in red, next to an outdoor charging station. No people.
shots.narration: 电动车电池，到指定地点充电。

shots.scene: 四个垃圾桶，其中红色有害垃圾桶亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four garbage bins in a row; the red hazardous waste bin lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 用完的危险物品，别随手扔。

shots.scene: 废电池、过期药、空杀虫剂罐依次投入红色桶
shots.prompt_en: A used battery, expired medicine and an empty insect spray can drop into the red bin one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 废电池、过期药、杀虫剂罐，投有害垃圾。

shots.scene: 城市垃圾分类告示图标，旁边空白文字
shots.prompt_en: A city waste sorting notice icon with blank text. No people.
shots.narration: 具体按所在城市的规定。

shots.section_title: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器
shots.scene: 厨房里液化气罐阀门旁冒出气体波纹
shots.prompt_en: Gas waves rise near the valve of an LPG cylinder in a kitchen. No people.
shots.narration: 闻到燃气味，怎么办？
overlay: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器

shots.section_title: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器
shots.scene: 手关闭阀门，然后推开窗户
shots.prompt_en: A hand closes the gas valve, then pushes the window open.
shots.narration: 先关阀门，再开窗通风。

shots.section_title: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器
shots.scene: 电灯开关、手机、打火机三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A light switch, a mobile phone and a lighter icon, all crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不开关电器，不打电话，不点火。

shots.section_title: 燃气泄漏：关阀开窗，不碰电器
shots.scene: 阿杰在室外拨电话，电话图标上写着 119
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call outdoors; a phone icon floats beside him.
shots.narration: 到室外安全处，再拨打 119。

shots.scene: 大海上一片油污，镜头推近到油滴里
shots.prompt_en: An oil slick on the sea; the view zooms in to a single oil droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 再说说：油污泄漏，微生物能帮忙。

shots.scene: 油滴周围聚集着杆状和球状的卡通微生物
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon rod-shaped and round microbes gather around the oil droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 有些细菌，专门分解石油烃。

shots.scene: 两个微生物图标下面贴着空白名牌
shots.prompt_en: Two microbe icons with blank name tags beneath them. No people.
shots.narration: 比如假单胞菌、食烷菌这类。

shots.scene: 微生物抱着一条长链分子，像在吃饭
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon microbe holds a long chain molecule like a meal. No people.
shots.narration: 它们把烃类当作食物。

shots.scene: 微生物身体里亮起电池和积木图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon and a building block icon light up inside the cartoon microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 既获取能量，又用来生长。

shots.section_title: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
shots.scene: 长链分子一步步被切短，变成小分子
shots.prompt_en: A long chain molecule is cut step by step into shorter pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 先把油氧化，变成脂肪酸。
overlay: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水

shots.section_title: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
shots.scene: 小分子最后变成气泡和水滴
shots.prompt_en: The small pieces finally turn into bubbles and water droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 最后分解成二氧化碳和水。

shots.section_title: 烃类生物降解，治理油污
shots.scene: 海面油污逐渐变淡，海水恢复清澈
shots.prompt_en: The oil slick gradually fades and the sea becomes clear again. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫烃类生物降解。
overlay: 烃类生物降解，治理油污

shots.section_title: 烃类生物降解，治理油污
shots.scene: 老周在实验室的生物安全柜里观察培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The older man observes a petri dish inside a biosafety cabinet in the lab.
shots.narration: 它是治理油污的重要办法之一。

shots.section_title: 实验菌株，不往外环境放
shots.scene: 小研从油污土壤样品中分离菌株，在安全柜里操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student isolates bacteria from an oily soil sample inside a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 环境里分出的菌，先评估再培养。
overlay: 实验菌株，不往外环境放

shots.section_title: 实验菌株，不往外环境放
shots.scene: 把培养液倒进下水道或花坛的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pouring culture liquid into a drain or a flower bed, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 培养物不倒下水道，不往外排。

shots.section_title: 实验菌株，不往外环境放
shots.scene: 高压灭菌器图标，培养物灭活后处置
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave icon; cultures are inactivated before disposal. No people.
shots.narration: 用完先灭菌，再按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 实验菌株，不往外环境放
shots.scene: 到野外投放菌剂需审批的印章图标
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp icon over a field release of microbes. No people.
shots.narration: 要到野外用菌，须经评估和批准。

shots.scene: 阿杰把两瓶清洁剂分开放好，开窗单独使用
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts the two cleaners away separately and opens the window to use one at a time.
shots.narration: 阿杰把清洁剂分开，单独使用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，五个物品图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where five household item icons light up one by one.
shots.narration: 清洁剂、燃料、电池、杀虫剂、药品。

shots.scene: 三个图标：电池充电、有害垃圾桶、关阀开窗
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a charging battery, a red hazardous waste bin, a closed valve with an open window.
shots.narration: 充电有人看，分类投放，燃气关阀。

shots.scene: 微生物抱着油滴，油滴变成气泡和水
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon microbe hugs an oil droplet, which turns into bubbles and water.
shots.narration: 微生物能吃油，菌株不外放。

shots.scene: 欣欣在干净的宿舍里向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye to the camera in a clean, tidy dorm room.
shots.narration: 实验室外也要讲安全，再见！
